alerts.title: Cooling loop B pressure below threshold
alerts.description: CHW loop B differential pressure dropped to 28 psi (threshold 34 psi). Supply temperature rising on halls C–D.
alerts.recommendedAction: Dispatch mechanical on-call, verify valve position, and stage spare pump if pressure does not recover within 10 minutes.

alerts.title: Rack A12 PDU load at 92%
alerts.description: PDU-A12 phase B load crossed 92% of rated capacity for 12 consecutive minutes.
alerts.recommendedAction: Redistribute non-critical loads or schedule capacity move before peak evening window.

alerts.title: Scheduled UPS battery test completed
alerts.description: Quarterly UPS battery discharge test finished successfully. Autonomy measured at 14.2 minutes.
alerts.recommendedAction: Archive test report and update maintenance log.

alerts.title: Fiber path redundancy reduced to single link
alerts.description: East metro fiber path is down for planned splice. West path remains active with elevated risk.
alerts.recommendedAction: Hold non-urgent maintenance until dual path restored; monitor latency SLOs.
